readme: HEARTROT arena geometry. THIS FILE IS THE MAP. Redraw `grid` in a text editor,
then run `python3 tools/gen_map.py` to recompile programs/heartrot/src/map.rs and
packages/client/src/map.ts. Never hand-edit either of those two files.
Layout, top to bottom -- docs/architecture/18-open-arena.md 2:
y=0        top border wall, ONE tile and it may never be two: the boss's
crown reaches world y=16, which is tile row 1, so a second border
row would sit inside the creature's own hittable extent and kill
every ray through it.
y=1..23    OPEN FLOOR, the boss's air. It MUST be floor and not wall: `shoot`'s
raycast tests `is_wall` before the part rectangles, so one wall tile
between a player and the boss kills every shot in that column. The
pit ceiling is a movement rule (map::PIT_TOP), not a wall.
y=24..34   `P` pit floor at full interior width, cols 2..61.
y=35..37   `P` pit floor, chamfered to cols 3..60, 5..58 and 9..54 so the pit
reads as a room with rounded lower corners rather than a box.
y=38..40   the doorway, 8 tiles wide at cols 28..35 and 3 rows deep. Also `P`,
so the raider band reaches down to the gate. A player who flips zone
standing on a gate tile is one step below PIT_BOT, so their next step
north is legal and they are not boxed out of every move.
y=41..42   `G` gate tiles, the block `enter_gate` demands you stand in.
y=43..62   the lobby. ZERO interior walls: the arena floor is open, and the
thirty 2x2 pillars that used to stand here are gone. Perimeter
architecture, banners, torches, chains and floor markings are ART
ONLY -- a decoration that becomes a wall tile re-creates the defect.
y=63       bottom border wall.
x=0..1, 62..63   side perimeter, TWO tiles. That thickness is what keeps the
lobby's far corner inside `shoot.rs`'s WORST_RANGE.
`B` at tile (32, 25) is the boss anchor: map::BOSS_SPAWN, world x 512 = the exact
centre line. The four `E` respawn doors sit at cols 10, 22, 41 and 53 on row 32,
two mirror pairs about x = 31.5.
gen_map.py refuses to emit a map whose entrances cannot reach the heart, whose
spawn points sit in a wall or outside the pit band, whose gate is not a solid
rectangle sitting immediately below the pit, whose pit is pinched in two by the
chamfer, whose rows are not mirror-symmetric, whose gate no lobby spawn can walk
to, that leaves any position in either zone with no legal move -- or that carries
a free-standing obstacle: every row must hold at most ONE contiguous run of
floor, which is the rule the pillar grid violated thirty times over.

legend.P: floor, pit - the raider box; the P bounding rows emit PIT_TOP/PIT_BOT
legend.G: floor, gate - the block enter_gate demands; emits GATE_MIN_X..GATE_MAX_Y
legend.E: floor, entrance - a respawn door, must flood-fill to the heart
legend.B: floor, heart of the chamber - the boss spawn tile
